title: Men from a twin-study institute try to take the twins
summary: Jim Weiner tells of Men from a twin-study institute try to take the twins, about late 1950s at Allentown area, Pennsylvania, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And shortly after that, these two guys showed up at our house and they wanted to talk to my father and mother. And they claimed that they were from some >> institute >> institute somewhere that was studying twins and they wanted to take Jack and I away to study us.

plain: Jim Weiner, who has a twin brother named Jack, says that in the late 1950s near Allentown, Pennsylvania, two men showed up at the family home asking to speak to his parents. He says the men claimed to be from an institute studying twins and wanted to take him and Jack away to study them. He tells it as an early strange event in a life story he connects to alien abduction.
